text: Program Description Length of Schooling and Degree Duration: 4 years Degree: Bachelor of Engineering Educational Objectives Mechanical Engineering Major is a broad major in mechanical engineering field. The professional training of mechanical engineering for senior engineer and technology expert has basic theories and knowledge in engineering design, manufacturing , technology development , scientific research , production organization and management. Main Courses Engineering Drawing and Computer Aided 、Theoretical Mechanics 、Material Mechanics 、Engineering Fluid Mechanics 、Fundamentals of Electro Techniques 、Fundamentals of Electronics 、Mechanical Principle 、Mechanical Design 、Fundamentals to Manufacturing 、Thermal Equipment Of Power Station and Running 、Test& Measuremen t Technology 、Thermal Theory Basis 、Hydraulic and Pneumatic Transmission 、Mechanical Manufacturing Technology 、Tolerance and Technical Measurement 、Computer Aided Design and Manufacturing 、Mechanical Manufacturing Equipment Design
